name: Draconic Ancestry
restriction: Restricted to characters native to Eberron, Forgotten Realms, Greyhawk, Mystara, or Planescape.
traits: Saving Throw Bonus +2 vs. Mind-Affecting Spells
notes: Does not change your race or subrace — you can still pass as a normal member of your race/subrace.
Major draconic features (full horns, tails, wings) are not allowed.
Outcast Rating increases by +4 or more, depending on how visible your chosen minor traits are.

name: Feytouched
traits: Hit Die becomes d6 (if lower than your current Hit Die)
Faerie Fire spell once a day
Charm Person spell once a day
notes: May be combined with another racial template.
Applies over any race or subrace.
Humans lose their extra skill point per level — a hardcoded side effect of the creature type changing to Fey.
Outcast Rating increases by +6 or more, depending on how visible your chosen minor traits are.

name: Blooded One
restriction: Restricted on this server to half-orcs from Thay and Calibans native to Hazlan.
traits: Blooded One War Cry spell-like ability once a day (all blooded ones within 30 feet, including self, gain +1 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls for 2d4 rounds)

name: Yuan-Ti Tainted One
restriction: Restricted to characters native to Forgotten Realms or Greyhawk.
traits: Poison spell-like ability once a day
Polymorph Self (Viper form only) three times a day
notes: Per a server dev note on the source thread, the spell-like abilities were pending a HAK update as of that post — verify current status in-game before relying on them.
